title: Raise from $40 to $75 per hour
decision: Ask the CEO and COO of Boost Oxygen for $75/hr (from $40/hr), justified by the AI automation systems built, and choose how to structure the ask.

hormozi.reason: Pricing your value against the value you create is his pillar

naval.reason: Rented hours versus leverage and equity is his pillar

buffett.reason: Cost to the company and downside if the ask fails

bezos.reason: Reversibility of the ask and the relationship

martell.reason: Whether the founder is the bottleneck or the buyer-back of time

leila.reason: How a CEO and COO react to a pay ask; leadership dynamics

wickman.reason: COO lens: ownership, accountability, documented systems

musk.reason: Real constraint and speed, at the edges

garyvee.reason: Storytelling and personal brand, at the edges

brief: An hourly employee at $40/hr who built AI automation systems for Boost Oxygen asks the CEO and COO for $75/hr. No impact numbers yet.
